# DJ Adams — qmacro.org

> Personal website and blog of DJ Adams (qmacro), Developer Advocate at SAP, based in the UK.
> Writing in British English since 2002. Opinions are many and firmly held.

DJ Adams is a long-standing SAP Developer Advocate, author, speaker, and live-streamer. He
created the first online SAP community in 1995 and co-created what is now SAP Community in 2003.
He has been blogging since 2002. He lives and works on a narrowboat named NB FULLY RESTFUL.

## Site structure

- Homepage: https://qmacro.org/
- About page: https://qmacro.org/about/
- Blog index: https://qmacro.org/blog/
- Tags index: https://qmacro.org/tags/
- RSS feed: https://qmacro.org/feed.xml

## Blog

The blog is the primary content on this site, with posts dating back to 2002. Posts are
organised by date (YYYY/MM/DD in the URL) and tagged. Most recent posts are in 2025-2026.

Blog post URLs follow the pattern:
https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/

## Primary topics (most active tags)

- **SAP CAP / CDS** (106 posts tagged cap, 62 tagged cds): The SAP Cloud Application Programming
  Model and its CDS language family (CDL, CQL, CXL). Deep technical content covering domain
  modelling, query languages, expressions, plugins, local-first development, and CAP philosophy.

- **Tools and developer experience** (189 posts tagged tools, 20 tagged developer-experience):
  Terminal tools, shell scripting, Neovim configuration, jq, Docker/containers, and personal
  development environment (PDE) setup.

- **Functional programming** (57 posts): jq, JavaScript (Ramda), Haskell, Clojure. Concepts
  include point-free coding, function composition, reduce as ur-function, data-last design.

- **Shell scripting** (72 posts): Bash, Unix tools, AWK, pipelines, shell best practices.

- **JavaScript** (76 posts): CAP Node.js, functional programming in JS, OData, UI5/Fiori.

- **SAP / SAP community** (172 posts tagged sap): SAP technology, community matters, developer
  advocacy.

- **OData** (30 posts): OData protocol, history, deep dives, tutorials. DJ was present at
  OData's creation from Atom Publishing Protocol.

- **Learning** (104 posts): Documenting learning openly, TIL posts, note-to-self entries.

- **Containers / Docker** (18 posts each): Container-based development, Dockerfiles, PDE setup.

- **Neovim** (9 posts): Lua-based configuration, LSP setup, CDS editing, Markdown editing.

- **jq** (40 posts): JSON processing, functional programming with jq, tool integration.

- **AI** (7 posts, growing): MCP, A2A, agents, Joule Studio — measured and critical perspective.

- **Computing history** (16 posts): ADM-3A terminal, BBC Micro, early SAP, origins of tools.

- **Narrowboat** (14 posts): Living and working on NB FULLY RESTFUL.

## Notable series

- **The Art and Science of CAP (TASC)**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2024/12/06/the-art-and-science-of-cap/
  A 9-part deep-dive series with CAP creator Daniel Hutzel covering CAP's philosophy, the
  Relational Model, functional programming foundations, and CDS internals.

- **Modules, modularity & reuse in CDS models**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2026/01/01/modules-modularity-and-reuse-in-cds-models/
  5-part series on NPM-based CDS reuse packages, from local development to GitHub Packages.

- **CDS expressions in CAP (CXL series)**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2025/12/09/a-new-hands-on-sap-dev-mini-series-on-the-core-expression-language-in-cds/
  6-part series on CXL, the core expression language in CDS.

- **Local-first dev with CAP Node.js**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2026/05/11/local-first-dev-with-cap-node-js/
  4-part series on mocking data, auth, remote services, and messaging during local development.

- **CAP Node.js Plugins**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2024/12/30/cap-node-js-plugins/
  3-part series on the CDS plugin mechanism.

- **Functional programming resources**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2025/03/24/functional-programming-resources/
  Meta-post collecting all FP-related content across blog posts, talks, and presentations.

- **OData Deep Dive**: https://qmacro.org/blog/posts/2026/02/02/odata-deep-dive-rewrite-in-the-open/
  Tutorial series on OData being rewritten in the open.

- **Monday Morning Thoughts** (38 posts): https://qmacro.org/tags/monday-morning-thoughts/
  Reflective opinion pieces on technology, community, and the developer life.

## Author voice and style

- Writes in British English (en-GB): colour, behaviour, artefact, favour.
- Opinionated, direct, warm. Uses cultural references freely (expects readers to look them up).
- Consistent structure: posts end with a "Wrapping up" section.
- Uses footnotes liberally for tangential detail.
- Reactions to elegant code or insights: "Boom!", "Wham!", 💥.
- "Note-to-self" and "TIL" posts document learning openly as it happens.
